events.name: Bash
events.head: Check evidence file, task state, grep

events.text: Evidence and log are on disk. Let me verify the evidence file contents back up the claims (0 clipped, key art 9/9) and re-run a live probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect evidence file and probe scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-11-verify.txt; grep -iE 'clip|key ?art|overflow|width|summary' workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-11-verify.txt | head -25; ls app/scripts | grep -i vip

events.text: Now an independent live rerun of shoot-vip on the mirror.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run shoot-vip on live mirror at 7 widths
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for w in 390 414 768 1024 1280 1440 1920; do echo "== $w"; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX="/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/?v=t094b" WIDTH=$w timeout 120 node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | grep -iE 'exhibit|overflow|error' | tail -3; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect shoot-vip output
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX="/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/?v=t094b" WIDTH=390 timeout 120 node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; grep -nE 'console.log|ROUTE' scripts/shoot-vip.mjs | head
